name: Enterprise Trinity River Supply Lateral

values.OtherEnglishNames: Enterprise Trinity River Supply Lateral; Trinity River Lateral
values.StartLocation: Trinity River Basin, north of Arlington
values.EndLocation: Sherman Extension interconnect near Justin, Denton County

researcher_notes: Not in the roster under any name (searched Trinity River, Enterprise Texas, Barnett). The EIA August 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 651, lists Enterprise Trinity River Supply Lateral by Enterprise Products Partners: completed 28 July 2010, 40 miles, 30 and 36 inch, 1,000 MMcf/d, intrastate in Texas. A Natural Gas Intelligence article from 2007 independently describes the proposed 40-mile, 30 to 36 inch lateral from the Trinity River Basin north of Arlington to the Sherman Extension near Justin, up to 1 Bcf/d, aimed at third quarter 2009. Sponsor, endpoints and a completed build are all met, and 40 miles (about 64 km) is over the 25 km rule. A Hart Energy completion report (July 2010) says the northern 9 miles of 36-inch and a 4-mile 20-inch spur entered service in September 2009 and the southern 31 miles of 30-inch in July 2010. That page could not be loaded by the verifier (access denied), so it is not cited. Start year 2010 is the date the full line was completed. Intrastate line, so absence from FERC is expected. Owner entity is Enterprise Products Partners LP in the team style; the Texas intrastate operator entity was not checked. Route not researched: no official GIS found, so no route. Class: new row, naming follows the Enterprise Texas system as a guess to confirm; PipelineName should be checked against the roster spelling before applying.
